title: Bounded filtered localization embeds fully faithfully in bounded-below filtered localization
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. A finitely filtered cochain complex is a cochain complex of $\mathcal A$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], with $F^aK=K$ and $F^{b+1}K=0$ for some integers $a\le b$ independent of the cochain degree. Morphisms preserve the filtration and homotopies preserve every filtration step. Let $K_F^b(\mathcal A)$ and $K_F^+(\mathcal A)$ be their bounded and bounded-below homotopy categories, respectively. A filtered quasi-isomorphism is a map inducing quasi-isomorphisms on every graded complex $\operatorname{gr}^pK=F^pK/F^{p+1}K$. The inclusion induces a fully faithful exact functor of triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category]
$$K_F^b(\mathcal A)[W_b^{-1}]\longrightarrow K_F^+(\mathcal A)[W_+^{-1}],$$
where $W_b$ and $W_+$ are the respective classes of filtered quasi-isomorphisms. The assertion also holds when a fixed finite filtration interval $[a,b]$ is imposed on all complexes, maps, and homotopies.
